data_fields.name: variable_tax_pct_range
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 to 3 stored (total 2 to 5 set by the leader)

data_fields.name: return_points_per_town

data_fields.name: hub_count_range
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 to 10 (literal in three places); ids run to 17

best_idea: A hub takes a tax on each service sale, the leader's rate change is held in reserve until the daily tick, and the monthly pool of the fixed tax is shared out per point of contribution, with the top contributor becoming the leader.
decision_why: The reserved-rate-until-tick rule and the contribution-shared monthly pool fit one ledger and zones as data; the tax maths must be fixed to one tax figure per sale, and the hard-coded town range 1 to 10 is rejected in favour of per-zone data.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a rate change made during the day is not charged until the daily tick, that a 30-coin sale at a 5 percent total rate charges the buyer exactly the amount the town books, and that the top contributor becomes leader after the monthly pass.
